events.event_name: New York Transit Museum Bus Festival
events.brand: New York Transit Museum and MTA New York City Transit
events.address: Emily Warren Roebling Plaza, 1 Water Street, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: Vintage buses at Brooklyn Bridge Park with boarding, activities, transit trivia and a scavenger hunt.
events.what_is_free: Festival admission, vintage-bus viewing and advertised activities are free.
events.caveats: Advance registration is encouraged but explicitly not required. The event runs rain or shine; buses and equipment are subject to change.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–3:30 PM at Emily Warren Roebling Plaza. Children 15 and under must be accompanied by an adult.

events.event_name: Vinyl Nights at Bella Abzug Park
events.brand: Vinyl Nights and Hudson Yards Hell's Kitchen Alliance
events.address: Bella Abzug Park, Hudson Boulevard East between West 34th Street and West 35th Street, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A free all-ages outdoor dance party with DJs playing vinyl across disco, funk, soul, house, boogie, Latin and hip-hop.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the outdoor dance event is free.
events.caveats: The district calendar confirms Sept. 19 from 6–9 PM. Current secondary listings describe advance RSVP as encouraged or available rather than required.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 6–9 PM in Bella Abzug Park between West 34th and West 35th Streets. All ages.

occurrences.details: Free; advance registration encouraged but not required.
Free all-ages outdoor dance party; RSVP available or encouraged, not established as required.
